content: unittest.mock.patch (stdlib) is the codebase's already-recommended approach (TESTING.md): patch requests.get/Session.get with MagicMock, set .json.return_value and .status_code. The responses library (getsentry/responses) offers a more declarative registration-based API (responses.add(...)) with less boilerplate for multi-call/pagination scenarios but is an added dependency. D-03 permits either; project TESTING.md already standardizes on unittest.mock with no new dependency.
